dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Hey there, buddy. I'm Tarno, of the Voynich Guild. Just let me know if you need anything, and I'll do whatever I can to help.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem very friendly.

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Oh, please! No need to be so wary. All that come here are guests of the guild, and it's only fair that my duties involve helping them however I can.

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Looking at you, though... Hmm, I'm guessing you're on the hunt for some legendary treasures.

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Well? Tell me about what you're looking for. You probably want some local help too, and hey, I've got lots of buddies in my back pocket who can lend a hand...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks, but no thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Haha, of course, no worries. Whenever you need help — and I do mean "whenever" — just come knocking on my door, buddy.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't think I'd talk to you about it, though.

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Haha, of course, it's natural to keep your guard up. That's good, friend, you'll be quite able to fend for yourself here in Nod-Krai.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can handle it myself.

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Well, well, that's a remarkably quick refusal, buddy. Are you a local, perhaps, rich in wisdom regarding the lay of the land? I should know your face, then...

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: ...But seeing as I do not, I do beg your pardon for never having noticed you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you sell here?

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Oh, I do sincerely apologize. Our new stock of goods is still in the midst of being sorted and stored... I'm afraid we have nothing to offer at present...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> looks like she has something to say...)

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Any special here for me?

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Lady Nefer! Well, this is a surprise. Is there something I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Heh, the no{RUBY#[D]spies from Snezhnaya}rth wind has stilled — I was just going out for a little walk. With weather this nice, it wouldn't hurt to relax a l{RUBY#[D]ease up on security}ittle every now and then, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: You're right, it is a fine day. It's just that the shipment of b{RUBY#[D]Kanjou Commission intel}ird-pattern brocade we ordered from Inazuma still hasn't come in. We merchants really do have to stay on top of these things, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Quite the effort you've all put in. In that case, once the brocade arrives, I would appreciate it if you could set a piece aside for me as well.

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Of course, Lady Nefer. Enjoy your walk.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have any special treasures?

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: ...Special treasures? Why, of course! We have a panoply of precious pieces... Though if you wish to take one, you're going to have to offer something special in exchange.

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Let me take a look... Ah, yes, as it happens, we're in urgent need of some "North Wind."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: North Wind?

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Just so! Once you've caught a gust or two, please make your way back here — I'll be eagerly awaiting your return.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Jahoda</color> looks like she has something to say...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Do you have any special treasures?

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Hello, Miss Jahoda, I haven't seen you in a while. Not since you—

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Alright, alright, we can skip the small talk, Tarno. The north{RUBY#[D]Snezhnaya spies}erly wind has been rather chi{RUBY#[D]rather active}lly over the last few days, and Boss Nef wants me to get some windproofing supplies here.

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Haha, got it. We wouldn't want to get frostbite from the northerly wind, yes. The windproofing supplies will be with you shortly. I should also tell you that although it's just a faint rustle of wind at this point, the Voynich Guild is already concerned.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Sure, sure. You people can talk to Boss Nef about that later on. But now, we have to act fast. I'll head back to report to her first.

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: I win. From the look on your face, though... Is something bothering you? You can tell me what's wrong, if you want. I might just have a solution.

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: You played well. And now, we are friends. If you need anything, do let me know.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you sell here?

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Here's the catalog for our guild's current products. Feel free to browse and purchase at your leisure.
